parameters.purpose: New pooled phase-aware initialization, evaluated on fresh source-excluded ranges and all three E049 long-key regressions. No unknown scans in this calibration batch.
parameters.pool: E051 twelve longest maximal non-F runs >=16, each capped256. Independent fragment phases, reset language context, first fragment phase zero gauge.
parameters.initializations: 16 per nominal period/sign. First phases allzero; second source offsets modulo period; third (source offset - floor(number of preceding ciphertext Fs/2)) modulo period; other13 uniform phases with Random(search_seed+1000*sign_index+period). All initialize key by exact pooled unigram coordinates.
parameters.schedule: Up to20 alternating exact unigram key/phase steps per start, stop fixedpoint. Retain two highest unigram starts per period/sign, cyclic-deduplicated. Each gets three bigram and three fourgram rounds: at most6 key coordinate sweeps then exact independent fragment phase optimization. No plaintext, key, period or mask oracle.
parameters.selection: Best fourgram pool candidate per nominal period/sign. Retain best sign per nominal period (16) plus top4 remaining opposite-sign candidates. Full-stream exact F-schedule optimization and up to3 rounds of6 key coordinate sweeps and schedule optimization. Final ranking uses full-stream score only. Top3 distinct plaintexts.
parameters.fresh_controls: Chapters X,XI,XII concatenated rune offsets4000:5200; keys17,23,31 from Random(3301052) sequential uniform1..28; signs+1,-1,+1; everyother plaintextF copied startingfirst. Spans197,263,311,429. Training I,III-IX unchanged. These are fresh ranges for this long-key calibration, not historically blind chapters.
parameters.regressions: All three E049 controls unchanged, including3316-rune X,1200-rune XI and XII. New solver counts as changed parameters.
parameters.null: One complete rerun on matched perpage conditional null of fresh XII with seed3302052+page_index. Preserve endpoints, histograms and adjacent equal pairs. Diagnostic score only; no p-value from one null. Same selection over all periods, signs and starts.
parameters.gate: All six controls must recover exact plaintext,key,sign and Fmask. Any failed control blocks unknown escalation. No unknown input is scanned in this batch even if gate passes; unknown-scope null plan must be separately frozen.
parameters.bounds: 512..4096 inputrunes, <=12 fragments, <=3072 pooledrunes,32 slots, <=256 fullDP states,29 coordinate rows,16 starts per32 families,64 retained pool candidates,20 fullstream candidates; estimated array working set <128MiB, process ceiling768MiB monitored by runner; one worker.
parameters.limits: Method motivated by earlier31-key failure. Fresh success is a synthetic control result, never a new Liber Primus decryption. No inference that failed heuristics exclude a cipher. No tuning after observing this batch.
